# Form

### Decisions

- **Form's role.** The `form` role exists only with an accessible name, so the role is set exactly when `accessibilityLabel` is; `role`, not `accessibilityRole`, carries the ARIA name on every platform.
- **FormItem's type.** The upstream item sets the compact body type on the container itself, so bare string children mount through the registry Text in `type.body_compact_01`.
- **FormGroup's legend.** The legend is a registry Text in `type.field_label` in the label color (the disabled label color while disabled), `spacing.spacing_03` below - the upstream label's bottom margin. `role: 'group'` names itself by the legend's generated id; `invalid` sets `aria-invalid` on the group and nothing else - the upstream's unstyled requirement block answers a `message` with a plain Text, not a new style.
- **Disabled is inherited.** A disabled group publishes the shared DisabledContext; the registry forces `disabled` on every component inside it, so a nested group passing `disabled: false` stays disabled, matching the upstream fieldset's disabling of descendant controls.
- **FormLabel has no margin.** The upstream label class drops the label margin for this member; the gap above a field belongs to the field, so the Text paints bare.
- **Members of a form only.** The roster keeps `requires_parent` on FormGroup and FormLabel: upstream mounts both only inside a Form, so they are not standalone components.

### Platform

A group, a form and a label are roles and ids on every platform; the disabling is a context value, not a DOM attribute, so it behaves identically on native.

## Form

Form groups a set of fields into one form.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Names the form; the `form` role exists only when a label is set. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The fields the form groups. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"A set of fields"}` |

## FormGroup

FormGroup gathers related fields under a legend, disabled or invalid as one, and must be composed inside Form.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `legendText` | `string` | yes | The legend text; it names the group through `aria-labelledby`. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The fields the group gathers; a disabled group disables them all. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the group and every control inside it, including a nested group that passes `disabled: false`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | no | Marks the group invalid (`aria-invalid`); it does not disable the fields. |
| `message` | `boolean` | no | Draws `messageText` under the fields and wires it by `aria-describedby`. Default `false`. |
| `messageText` | `string` | no | The message text, drawn when `message` is true. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `legendGap` | `spacing.spacing_03` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"legendText":"Delivery address","children":["Street","City"]}` |
| disabled | `{"legendText":"Delivery address","disabled":true,"children":["Street","City"]}` |
| message | `{"legendText":"Delivery address","message":true,"messageText":"Check the address for typos.","children":["Street","City"]}` |

## FormLabel

FormLabel draws a field label in the theme's label type and color and must be composed inside Form.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The label text. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Draws the label in the disabled label color. |
| `id` | `string` | no | The label element's id, for a control to name itself by `aria-labelledby`. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the label. |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Street"}` |
| disabled | `{"children":"Street","disabled":true}` |
